facts.business: Morepen Laboratories Limited is a diversified pharmaceutical company engaged in APIs, CDMO, Formulations, OTC, Home Healthcare, and Medical Devices businesses with integrated manufacturing and R&D capabilities.

capacity_or_capex.item: 1,100 KW (1.1 MW) Solar Power Plant at Baddi site
Six Pressure Reducing Valves (PRVs) at SRP, Boiler, MEE and Plant
Two Heat Max systems at Process Plant, BDI site
Level Transmitters-cum-Controllers at hot-water tanks (Boiler, MEE, P10)
Air Vent modules, PAPPU pumps and PRV systems at various plant locations
Replacement of 8 aluminium blade cooling tower fans
DI (deionised) water flow meters at Baddi and Masulkhana sites

guidance_or_targets.statement: Expected annual revenue growth of 15–20% over the medium term
Expected improvement in EBITDA margins by approximately 150–250 basis points
Expected ROCE improvement of 2–4 percentage points
Recently secured ₹825 crore multi-year CDMO contract

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: No qualifications, reservations, adverse remarks or disclaimers in standalone financial statements; Cost Audit Report also unqualified

key_risks: Market conditions and regulatory approvals impacting growth targets
Dependence on successful commercialization of new molecules and regulatory filings
Execution risk on long-term manufacturing contracts
